name: Blank
desc: Start completely from scratch — no stats, no trackers, nothing predefined.

name: Narrative
desc: Storytelling without rules — no stats, no skill checks. Just characters, prose, and a world that moves through days, dates and clock time.

name: Fantasy
desc: Swords, sorcery and adventure — a classic medieval fantasy world of kingdoms, dungeons and magic.

name: Space Sci-fi
desc: Starbases, alien worlds and deep-space voyages — a galaxy of exploration and danger.

name: Cyberpunk
desc: High tech, low life — neon megacities, street chrome and corporate shadow-wars.

name: Modern
desc: Everyday life in the modern city — work, friends, rent and ambitions.

name: Horror
desc: Survive the dark — haunted towns, fragile minds, and things that hunt by sound.

name: Post-Apocalyptic
desc: Dust, rust and static — water, bullets and engines across the wastes.

name: Drama
desc: Feelings with consequences — reputation, romance and high-stakes city life.
